points.title: What SQL is
points.must: SQL = Structured Query Language, the standard language to create, manage and query relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL…); declarative — says what, not how.

points.title: DDL definition
points.must: DDL = Data Definition Language: defines / changes the structure (schema) — tables, fields, types, keys; commands CREATE, ALTER, DROP.

points.title: DML definition
points.must: DML = Data Manipulation Language: works with the data / records in the tables; commands SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

points.title: DDL vs DML comparison
points.must: A comparison (table) of DDL and DML: purpose, commands, what is affected (schema vs records), an example of each.

points.title: SQL style rules
points.must: Keywords in capitals, text and dates in single quotes, numbers without quotes, statement ends with ;, no spaces in names.

points.title: Data type definition
points.must: A data type is the kind of data a field stores; it decides the values accepted, the storage and the operations possible.

points.title: SQL data types
points.must: INT, FLOAT/DOUBLE, DECIMAL(p,s), VARCHAR(n), CHAR(n), TEXT, DATE, DATETIME, BOOLEAN — each with an example field.

points.title: CHAR vs VARCHAR and DECIMAL(p,s)
points.must: CHAR(n) is fixed length (padded), VARCHAR(n) up to n characters; DECIMAL(p,s) = p digits in total, s after the point.

points.title: Choosing types
points.must: Phone numbers, IIN and codes as text (leading 0 / +); money as DECIMAL; dates as DATE; yes/no as BOOLEAN — with the reason.

points.title: Constraints
points.must: PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL, UNIQUE, DEFAULT, CHECK, AUTO_INCREMENT, FOREIGN KEY … REFERENCES and what each does.

points.title: CREATE DATABASE / CREATE TABLE
points.must: A full CREATE TABLE example: one line per field with name, type (size) and constraints, commas between lines, primary key, closing );.

points.title: ALTER TABLE
points.must: ALTER TABLE … ADD field type; MODIFY; DROP COLUMN; RENAME COLUMN — with an example; records stay, structure changes.

points.title: DROP
points.must: DROP TABLE / DROP DATABASE delete the structure and all the data; cannot be undone — back up first.

points.title: Common mistakes
points.must: At least two: spaces in names, missing / extra commas, DELETE instead of DROP COLUMN, SELECT called DDL, VARCHAR without size.
